# secobserve_authorization_group (Data Source)

Looks up an authorization group by id or exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "secobserve_authorization_group" "platform_team" {
  name = "Platform Team"
}

output "platform_team_manages_itself" {
  value = data.secobserve_authorization_group.platform_team.is_manager
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the authorization group. Supply either this or `name`.
- `name` (String) Exact name of the authorization group. Supply either this or `id`. Matching is exact and case-sensitive, even though SecObserve's own filter is a substring match.

### Read-Only

- `has_product_group_members` (Boolean) Whether the group has a role on any product group.
- `has_product_members` (Boolean) Whether the group has a role on any product.
- `has_users` (Boolean) Whether the group has any members.
- `is_manager` (Boolean) Whether the provider's own identity manages this group.
- `oidc_group` (String) IdP group claim this group is mapped to, if any.
